title: NEVERBALL
subtitle: Robert Kooima and the Neverball team, 2014 — 1.6.0 on SDL 2 and OpenGL, its levels compiled from their .map sources by its own mapc, built by PRISM

needsData.hint: the release's data/ for Neverball (not Neverputt) without its .map sources, and the .sol levels tools/neverball-sols.mjs compiles from them; 117 MB, each file fetched when the game opens it

_why: The first SDL 2 program here that draws through OpenGL (src/env/sdl2gl.js), on the three extensions gl.js gained for it: vertex buffer objects, point parameters and sprites, and a multitexture of one unit -- so Neverball takes its single-unit pipeline, without the ball's shadow.
